item.text:
scope batch-defect-calculation
  observation line-a-output
    Components produced by Line A.
    quantity 120 component measured

  observation line-a-defect-rate
    Exact expected defect proportion for Line A.
    quantity 4 percent assumed

  observation line-b-output
    Components produced by Line B.
    quantity 80 component measured

  observation line-b-defect-rate
    Exact expected defect proportion for Line B.
    quantity 10 percent assumed

  claim total-output
    Combined component output.
    = line-a-output + line-b-output

  claim weighted-defect-total
    Sum of each line's output weighted by its defect percentage.
    = line-a-output * line-a-defect-rate + line-b-output * line-b-defect-rate

  claim batch-defect-percentage
    Overall defect percentage of the combined batch.
    = weighted-defect-total / total-output

  option option-d
    The choice corresponding to the computed batch defect percentage.

  link batch-defect-percentage supports option-d

  claim final-answer
    The answer is D.

  link option-d supports final-answer

  model holds final-answer
    confidence 1 assumed
